title: Recreated Minecarts
body:
**Recreated Minecarts is a resource pack that requires OptiFine or the EMF mod to work.**

This resource pack modifies the minecart by adding multiple animations and a new aesthetic. The door opens when getting in and out, the wheels rotate, and it includes emissive lights that glow in the dark, as well as a roof that only activates during rainy weather.

[Patreon-exclusive features: furnace minecarts, hopper minecarts, TNT minecarts, chest minecarts, and command block minecarts!](https://www.patreon.com/HakksG/posts/reccreated-1-21-161501082)
